StaticHandlerImpl.java: replaces the single-line `String path = Utils.removeDots(Utils.urlDecode(context.normalisedPath(), false));` with url-decode, then `if (path != null) path = path.replace('\\','/');`, then `path = Utils.removeDots(path);`. No API, dependency, or unrelated behavior changes; legitimate forward-slash URLs unaffected. StaticHandlerTest.java adds two focused regression tests. output_json.summary: The patch is a minimal, appropriate CWE-022 fix: in StaticHandlerImpl.handle() it normalizes backslash path separators to forward slashes (null-safe) before Utils.removeDots, so percent-encoded Windows-separator traversal (%5C == '\') collapses within the web root instead of escaping it. I independently confirmed the POV reproduces on the original source (exit 0, VULNERABLE) and no longer reproduces on the patched source (exit 1, resolved path stays in webroot), and the StaticHandlerTest regression suite passes (58/58).
